K-ETA Application Guide
Eligible Countries / Applicants
You can apply for K-ETA if you hold a passport from countries or regions listed below.

Applicant
01
Foreigners intending to enter
the Republic of Korea without a visa
02
People intending to stay for a short period of time for travel, visiting relatives, attending events or conferences, or business purposes
(no commercial activities allowed)
03
A person who is not eligible for exemption from application (exemption)
Check the criteria for exemption
A person who meets all three conditions above
Items to prepare for K-ETA application
01
Valid passport
02
Valid e-mail address
03
ID photo
04
Credit or debit cards
that can be used to pay the fee
※ The fee is 10,000 KRW
approximately USD $7~8 per person.
Those eligible for application exemption
1. Diplomatic · Official passport holders
2. Active service members of the United States Armed Forces according to the US-ROK Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA)
3. Aircraft and ship crew members
4. ABTC (APEC) holders
5. Transfer passengers
6. Registered foreigners and VISA holders
7. UN passport holders
8. Those who are 17 years old and younger or 65 years old and older (on the date of entry)
